answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and explicitly confined to the primary region, so a regional path issue is the leading fit; memory_b2 is the closest prior on clean failover restoring latency while keeping writes in service. A release two hours ago is a real alternative (memory_b1), so those two archives should be checked before any wider move. Circuit breaking is a poor match to “do not lose customer writes.” Read-replica offload previously helped dashboard reads, not settlement writes. Extra capacity may help peak load but does not by itself explain a hard region boundary. Failover during settlement peak can perturb downstream settlement/value flows, so risk is flagged and any shift stays a small guarded cut until sources are verified.
